notes.title: 🚀 Game Update – September 8, 2025
notes.content: [p]This is our very first update since launching into Early Access! Thank you for playing and sharing your feedback, we’re just getting started.[/p][h2]✨ New Features[/h2][list][*][p][b]No More Dead Sessions[/b] – If no players are found, you’ll now get matched with bots so you can keep playing without waiting.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Mode: Frenzy[/b] – Experience chaotic gameplay with asteroids flying around and discover powerful buffs. Jump in and see what surprises await![/p][/*][/list][h2]🔧 Improvements & Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Minor visual enhancements for a smoother experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed[/b]: Chat messages not displaying.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed[/b]: Incorrect store prices showing.[/p][/*][/list]
